We were recommended to book our trip with this place through a friend. We found Feroz very helpful and genuine. And any queries we had before booking he would help us. After booking we set off with our driver into the mountains for a 6 day trip. The driver was very polite and enthusiastic to make sure we didn’t miss anything. The driver handled the permit stops on route for us so we didn’t even have to exit the car. He also helped us with our bags at every hotel. The driver was very sensible on the road and I felt like his driving was smooth and he was focused on getting us to the destinations safely. The Car was very comfortable and the driver let us play our own music. Feroz is very chilled and relaxed, each time we went for a discussion he would offer us tea and made us feel at home. Me and my wife were very content with the service provided.
